Basic chat completion against real Google Gemini API

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("GEMINI_API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"max_tokens\":10,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in exactly one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite\"}")
IO.inspect(result)
```
